paragraphs: A Jaguar AJ300D engine rebuild starts from £2,800.

A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required - submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Jaguar already has instead - strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ300D owners choose, and it's the one we'd recommend for most situations.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting - sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call - particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries. Enter your reg below and we'll talk you through both options honestly.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild - a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle - restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers for your F-Pace D300.

faqLeft.q: What is the Jaguar AJ300D engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ300D is Jaguar Land Rover's 3.0-litre straight-six diesel engine from the Ingenium family, in production since 2019. It's a twin-turbocharged unit with 48V mild-hybrid assistance.

faqLeft.q: Which Jaguar models use the AJ300D?
faqLeft.a: The AJ300D is fitted exclusively to the F-Pace D300 (X761, 2019-present).

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ300D differ between models?
faqLeft.a: Within the Jaguar range, the AJ300D is a single-application engine. It's also used in Land Rover vehicles, but with different ancillaries and calibration.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ300D from a Land Rover compatible with a Jaguar?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. Ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ between brands and models, even though the base engine code is the same. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar AJ300D engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.a: Yes. We work on AJ300D rebuilds for the F-Pace D300, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you work on AJ300D mild-hybrid applications?
faqRight.a: Yes. The F-Pace D300 uses the 48V MHEV system, which is accounted for during a rebuild.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ300D engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ300D owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
